question: What claim about the functions attributed here is at stake in listing killing, uprooting, paralyzing, deluding and so forth?
premises: Killing and uprooting are attributed in this context.
Paralyzing, deluding and so forth are attributed in this context.
These are addressed to the fortunate and beloved one.
inference: A set of specific operative functions is attributed to this practice or circle.
uncertainties: The agent by whom these functions are carried out is not specified here.
plain_english: Killing, uprooting, paralyzing, deluding and so forth, O fortunate and beloved one.
